content.title: LIST: Central Virginia schools closed, virtual on Monday due to severe weather
content.text: by: Alex Roever Posted: Mar 15, 2026 / 04:38 PM EDT Updated: Mar 15, 2026 / 09:58 PM EDT by: Alex Roever Posted: Mar 15, 2026 / 04:38 PM EDT Updated: Mar 15, 2026 / 09:58 PM EDT RICHMOND, Va. (WRIC) — Some school districts in central Virginia will be closed or shift to virtual learning on Monday due to severe thunderstorms. School districts across central Virginia will either be closed or shift to virtual learning due to the severe storm traveling through the state on Monday afternoon. StromTracker8 has forecasted high winds with a risk of hail and tornadoes. The following school districts will be closed on Monday, March 15: Amelia County Public Schools Brunswick County Public Schools Buckingham County Public Schools Caroline County Public Schools Charles City County Public Schools Chesterfield County Public Schools Colonial Heights Public Schools Cumberland County Public Schools Dinwiddie County Public Schools Essex County Public Schools Fluvanna County Public Schools Fredericksburg City Public Schools Goochland County Public Schools Greensville County Public Schools Hanover County Public Schools Hopewell City Public Schools King and Queen County Public Schools King William County Public Schools Lancaster County Public Schools Lunenburg County Public Schools Mecklenburg County Public Schools Middlesex County Public Schools Northumberland County Public Schools Nottoway County Public Schools Orange County Public Schools Petersburg City Public Schools Powhatan County Public Schools Prince Edward County Public Schools Prince George County Public Schools Richmond County Public Schools Sussex County Public Schools The following school districts will have a remote learning day on Monday: Henrico County Public Schools Richmond Public Schools Spotsylvania County Public Schools Stafford County Schools This article will be updated if and when additional delays or closings are announced.
